page: Microsoft Azure E64ds_v5 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz. It features 64 virtual CPUs mapped to 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The memory configuration provides 512.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled with a 2458 GB local disk, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 62149.91 and a PassMark CPU score of 61141.72. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient for large blocks, registering 292.62 GB/sec for read-only and 134.23 GB/sec for write operations. Single-core performance is moderate, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 1683.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1899.09. The system excels in parallelized tasks, achieving a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression speed of 300.08 GB/sec and a static web serving throughput of 52.6 GB/sec.

While the server demonstrates strong capabilities in database operations with a PassMark database score of 30592.05, it exhibits limitations in large-scale AI workloads. Without GPU acceleration, LLM text generation using a large 70B model is weak, averaging 2.72 tokens/sec. Consequently, this instance is best suited for memory-intensive enterprise applications, relational databases, data caching layers, and multi-threaded data processing pipelines rather than large-scale deep learning inference.

It features a 2458 GB local disk and is Premium Storage capable under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The server delivers strong multi-core and memory performance, as evidenced by a PassMark CPU score of 61141.72 and large-block memory read bandwidth of 292.62 GB/sec. However, single-core metrics are average, and large LLM text generation is weak at 2.72 tokens/sec due to the lack of GPU acceleration. This hardware profile is highly cost-efficient for memory-heavy workloads, making it suitable for large databases, multi-threaded data processing, and static web serving.
